capabilities: Subscribe to MQTT 3.1.1/5 broker topics over mqtt, mqtts, ws, and wss
Route messages into notes using ordered first-match rules with templates and insertion modes
Download message attachments into the vault with size and origin checks
Publish processing results back to an MQTT topic via an outbox
Persist accepted messages to a checksummed state file for crash recovery
disambiguation: Not a vault synchronization tool despite the name; "sync" refers to MQTT message transport, and it explicitly does not keep notes in sync across devices.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.12.7+. It is not a 24x7 collector and cannot receive while Obsidian is closed. Release assets carry GitHub build-provenance attestations. Flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to receive messages from MQTT devices, gateways, and automations, so machine-generated data cannot be captured into notes without manual copying.
summary: MQTT client that subscribes to a broker, then routes incoming messages into Markdown notes via ordered first-match rules, with attachments and result publishing.
